unruled:ny_city_rs#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A: "One spouse is a New York State resident and the other is a nonresident or part-year resident. In this case, you must either: file separate New York returns ... or file jointly, as if you both were New York State residents". A joint federal return reaches this only through ny_it201.ask.spouse_resident ('Did your husband or wife also live in New York City for all of 2025?', asked on a joint return): a No makes ny_it201.spouse_not_resident true, and ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident (a choice on f1040.status: mfj reads spouse_not_resident; single, mfs, hoh and qss give no) refuses ny_it201.line1 ('Separate New York returns, or a joint return taxing both as residents'); a refused IT-201 is a refused New York profile, so the status item of this form is never produced for that case. A federal separate return keeps New York status 3, which the exception does not change.

unruled:ny_rs#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 4, Item A: "One spouse is a New York State resident and the other is a nonresident or part-year resident. In this case, you must either: file separate New York returns ... or file jointly, as if you both were New York State residents". A joint federal return reaches this only through ny_it201.ask.spouse_resident ('Did your husband or wife also live in New York City for all of 2025?', asked on a joint return): a No makes ny_it201.spouse_not_resident true, and ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident (a choice on f1040.status: mfj reads spouse_not_resident; single, mfs, hoh and qss give no) refuses ny_it201.line1 ('Separate New York returns, or a joint return taxing both as residents'); a refused IT-201 is a refused New York profile, so the status item of this form is never produced for that case. A federal separate return keeps New York status 3, which the exception does not change.

unruled:ny_it201#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 5: a federal joint filer whose spouse's 'address or whereabouts ... is unknown', or who 'refuses to sign a joint New York return' with evidence of alienation, may file a separate New York return; only ny_it201.gate.spouse_nonresident is encoded. Already filed as BUG-1095 (open, low).

unruled:ny_it201#1.2.evidence: ny_it201i p. 23, the 110% rule 'and you are not a farmer or a fisherman'. ny_it201.safe_harbor's note: the exception is not asked, so a fisherman is held to 110%, which can only refuse more often; a farmer is refused federally by scope.farm. No wrong amount.

unruled:ny_it201#1.3.evidence: ny_it201i p. 6, codes C7 and M4 to M9 concern servicemembers and their spouses; ny_it201.ask.active_duty ('were you (or, on a joint return, your spouse) on active duty in the U.S. armed forces?') refuses the New York part. Code E4 is for a U.S. nonresident noncitizen, refused federally by scope.nonresident.

unruled:ny_it201#1.4.evidence: ny_it201i p. 5, Items E and F: the New York City living-quarters mark, the day count and the months of City residence are entries on the return that change no amount; a part-year City resident is refused (ny_it201.gate.part_year_city).

unruled:ny_it2#1.1.evidence: ny_it201i p. 21, 'If you received foreign income but did not receive a federal Form W-2, you must complete Form IT-2.' Foreign pay with no Form W-2 is refused federally by scope.pay_no_w2 ('Wages, tips, or strike or lockout pay not on a W-2'), and income excluded as earned abroad by sa.excluded_income, so no New York return reaches IT-2 with such income.

unruled:ny_it201#1.5.evidence: ny_it201i p. 5, Items B and D1: marks copying the federal itemizing choice and Schedule B Part III; they change no amount.

unruled:ny_it201#1.6.evidence: ny_it201i p. 22: the copy of an estate's or trust's notification is an attachment; estate and trust K-1s are refused federally by scope.k1, and the line 75 amount is unchanged.
